subject.title: fix(agents): strip leaked truncation sentinels from final replies (#82121)

question: Should central final-reply cleanup globally remove standalone marker-shaped plaintext, or must truncation cleanup stay limited to producer/display provenance or another proven internal boundary?
rationale: The current PR chooses global final-text deletion, while a related member review rejected that shape because it can remove legitimate user-intended plaintext or copied logs.

options.title: Require Provenance-Safe Cleanup
options.body: Ask the PR to restrict removal to internal producer/display provenance or otherwise preserve literal marker-shaped plaintext before merge.

options.title: Accept Global Sanitizer Deletion
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept that standalone marker-shaped final reply lines can be removed even when user-intended.

options.title: Pause For Boundary Coordination
options.body: Pause this PR until the overlapping sanitizer and session-hydration work define the permanent truncation-marker boundary.

recommendation.title: Require Provenance-Safe Cleanup
recommendation.body: Ask the PR to restrict removal to internal producer/display provenance or otherwise preserve literal marker-shaped plaintext before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He already made the directly relevant boundary decision on the related hydration PR.
